newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiei drops due to sale of shareholding.
newsitem.headline: Daiei drops due to sale of shareholding.

text.p: Shares of Daiei Inc dropped in afternoon trade on Friday, after it announced that it had sold off 20 billion yen worth of shares due to poor earnings for the current business year to March 31, 1997, traders said.
The share price was down 40 yen at 1,040 at 0552 GMT. Turnover was 1.097 million shares.
Daiei also said on Friday that it would announce a revision of its earnings forecast, and sales of shareholdings after 3 p.m. (0600 GMT).
Daiei did not disclose its latest earnings forecast for the current fiscal year.
